name: Unbounce
summary: Landing page builder for paid campaigns, with A/B testing and Smart Traffic routing each visitor to the best-converting variant.
best_for: PPC specialists and agencies running paid campaigns who want A/B testing and Smart Traffic (AI routing each visitor to the best-converting variant)
skip_if: your traffic or budget is small, or you want cheap unlimited pages — Landingi starts around $29/mo for similar basics
honest_knock: The entry price is high for a landing-page tool, and the visitor caps bite if a campaign takes off. It's also oddly behind on basics — no URL import, limited file/code management, and still no true AI page generation in 2026.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month, or $22 billed yearly at 25% off
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-03 on their own pricing page, USD) Five published levels, monthly against yearly at 25% off: Starter $29 / $22, Build $99 / $74, Experiment $149 / $112, Optimize $249 / $187, plus Concierge custom pricing above that. The Starter tier is missing from most summaries, ours included until the August 2026 update, which described the range as beginning at $74. Pages are unlimited from Build up; Starter allows 5 pages and up to 500 visitors, 1 user and 1 root domain. Above Starter what pushes you up a tier is the visitor cap (20k on Build, 30k on Experiment, 50k on Optimize), so a traffic spike rather than a page count is what changes your bill. Every plan now lists an MCP server, and the 14-day trial still needs no credit card. Unlimited A/B testing starts at Experiment, and AI traffic optimization at Optimize.

compare_with.name: Instapage or Landingi
compare_with.why: the other premium and the budget landing-page builders
